principle: Add new isolated services and preserve all existing production routes, bindings, mail behaviour, contact behaviour and secrets.

protectedWorkers.name: gnk-asg-direct-operator
protectedWorkers.changePolicy: No route, binding or secret changes during redesign deployment.

protectedWorkers.name: gnk-asg-contact-api
protectedWorkers.changePolicy: No route or binding changes; frontend remains a compatible client.

protectedWorkers.name: gnk-asg-ai-assist-worker
protectedWorkers.changePolicy: Keep public assistant isolated from admin execution privileges.

protectedWorkers.name: gnk-asg-auto-editor
protectedWorkers.changePolicy: Command Center invokes through a service binding; existing public routes remain unchanged.

protectedWorkers.name: gnk-asg-publish-operator
protectedWorkers.changePolicy: Command Center may call it only through an approved service binding and explicit publication policy.

newIsolatedWorker.name: gnk-asg-command-center-worker
newIsolatedWorker.cronLogic: Hourly check with Europe/Zagreb guard; article every 3 hours and daily digest once at configured local hour.

deploymentOrder: Create preview Command Center Worker without production routes
Attach existing KV and AI bindings without modifying source workers
Attach service bindings to existing Auto Editor, Direct Operator and Publish Operator
Add OPERATOR_TOKEN as a Cloudflare secret
Run dry-run plan, queue, schedule, editor and digest tests
Test mail, contact, AI, R2 upload, publications and all protected routes
Create Cloudflare version snapshot and GitHub repository snapshot
Only after explicit approval add command.gnk-asg.hr custom domain
Keep schedule disabled until explicit automation approval

rollback.existingWorkers: No rollback needed because their routes and configs are not changed.
rollback.commandCenter: Remove custom domain or disable the new Worker schedule.
rollback.frontend: Return to the previous Git commit or Cloudflare Worker version.
rollback.data: Queue, logs and schedule use isolated KV keys and can be disabled without deleting existing portal content.
